findings.title: Wrapper and GO generator do not value-pin token schema literals or the readiness review file's schema and canonical path
findings.evidence: Empirical probes: in the 72-case authority battery, mutations token.schema='EVIL' and token.schema_version='9.9.9' passed validate_authority (the field census requires key presence but the values are never compared to the live-go literals), and a review file whose schema value was swapped to the capture-review schema also passed because scripts/research/f017_apple_serial_f32_equivalence_wrapper_v3.py lines 162-164 and the GO generator lines 49-51 check only reviewer_model, verdict, and reviewed_head on the loaded review document, never its schema or its path against the canonical readiness response path. The repo at the reviewed head contains 13 committed ACCEPT reviews by claude-fable-5 with reviewed_head fields (for example the capture cycle-02 review at head 3fb41455...), so a mis-authored human approval could bind a different accepted review surface and still satisfy READINESS_REVIEW_AUTHORITY. Not weakening today: the entire review-chain gate is new in this readiness revision (cycle-1's wrapper had no review-chain check at all), the review file must be committed in-repo and hash-bound inside the human-signed approval, every authority-bearing scope field is pinned to release constants, the approval statement is release-v4-specific, and at approval time the unique intended bind target is this cycle-02 execution-readiness review at the independently accepted head.
findings.required_action: In a wrapper-v3/GO-generator revision, pin token schema=='pulsarmlx.f017.apple-production-serial-f32-live-go' and schema_version=='1.0.0', pin the loaded review document's schema=='pulsarmlx.f017.apple-production-serial-f32-execution-readiness-independent-review', and pin approval.readiness_review_path to the canonical cycle response path for the accepted readiness review.
findings.disposition: DEFENSE_IN_DEPTH_NON_WEAKENING; exact bind point: wrapper-v3/go-generator revision plus code-manifest update, landed and independently re-reviewed strictly before any human approval is signed or the operator-only GO generator is invoked.

findings.title: Load-bearing helper module f017_apple_serial_f32_capture_wrapper_v2.py is absent from the code-manifest-v3 freeze census
findings.evidence: Wrapper-v3, the GO generator, and terminalizer-v2 all import GateError, load_unique, sha, durable_create, owner_matches, terminalize_owned_failure, and validate_capture from scripts/research/f017_apple_serial_f32_capture_wrapper_v2.py, but that file is not among the 21 artifacts of code-manifest-v3 (nor was it in v2, so this is a pre-existing cycle-1-surface gap, not a regression), and no release-v4 binding rehashes it; post-acceptance drift of this one module would therefore not be caught by preflight rehash while every pinned hash still passes. Not weakening today: the live file rehashes to 1380cc10c06df2cd5d5662997f7ce2849b3fb33eea5293ab630762d1bcf14e21, byte-identical to the wrapper-v2 bytes recorded and reviewed in the cycle-01 independent review, unchanged since commit 2deb3c9 and byte-identical between execution_code_head 2af52b5 and the reviewed head; the file is committed at the pinned execution_code_head that is bound into the release, approval, token, and durable attempt-start; the arithmetic and capture-writing authority is the immutable pinned Rust executable, which takes no input from this module; and the read-only reconciler plus mandatory same-commit banking with independent review of the future result provide post-hoc detection of any mis-terminalization.
findings.required_action: Add scripts/research/f017_apple_serial_f32_capture_wrapper_v2.py (and any other module transitively imported by the execution wrapper, GO generator, or terminalizer) to the next code-manifest revision so preflight rehashes it before attempt-start.
findings.disposition: DEFENSE_IN_DEPTH_NON_WEAKENING; exact bind point: code-manifest v4 revision landed and independently re-reviewed strictly before any human approval is signed or any live GO token is issued.
